findings.title: The login-query cache conflates a null organization ID with an empty organization ID
findings.body: `getForLogin`'s delegate distinguishes `organizationId == null` (all public organization IDPs for ORG_ONLY/ALL) from `organizationId.equals("")` (a specific, empty ID search), but both are stored under the same `searchKey` (`""`). Consequently, a call with an empty ID can reuse the unscoped null-ID result and expose IDPs from every organization, or an unscoped call can reuse an empty result cached by the empty-ID call. Use a distinct sentinel for null (or otherwise encode null separately) so the cache preserves the delegate method's behavior.

findings.title: The new test registers cleanup for the literal alias instead of each created IDP
findings.body: Each iteration creates `idp-alias-<i>`, but the cleanup action targets `identityProviders().get("alias")`. Therefore none of the 20 providers created by this test (nor the later `idp-alias-20`) are removed by the registered cleanup. This pollutes the shared test realm and can make repeated execution or later tests observe unexpected providers. Register cleanup using the iteration's actual alias.
